data.title: 玛奇玛 · 支配之夜·恶魔真身与血色光环
data.description: 【玛奇玛 · 支配之夜】暴雨倾盆的神社鸟居长阶之上，玛奇玛撑着一把黑伞静静伫立在漫天雨幕中。她优雅地摘下黑色皮手套，身后缠绕着令人窒息的无形支配气场——「无论恶魔还是人类，在绝对的支配面前皆一视同仁。跪伏在我的脚下吧，这是你唯一的归宿。」
data.location: 黄昏鸟居之巅与血色云海
data.action: 撑着黑伞站在暴雨中的神社长阶上，俯视前方
data.lighting: 暴雨中的阴晦天光与湿润反光
data.camera: low angle epic cinematic shot, storm clouds, dominating aura
data.promptProse: Makima holds a black umbrella on the storm-swept shrine staircase, gazing downward with golden concentric eyes beneath her single crimson braid and tailored suit. The low view follows the long steps toward her supported stance, timber shrine structures behind. Dim storm daylight reflects from wet stone and umbrella edges; rain streaks cross the darker stair recesses, leaving her face sheltered under the canopy and the shining steps to establish the depth.
